The owner just wants to accept bookings  both offline and online even if he didn't have the room.

I booked three rooms at this hotel around 20 days in advance for an official meeting in Gurgaon on April 6th. However, upon arrival in the morning, we were informed by the lady at the reception that no rooms were available. After waiting for an hour, we were told there were still no rooms and were directed to another branch at sector 9.The alternative accommodation provided was far below our expectations. The rooms were of Oyo type, had a stale odor, and were in a pathetic condition. It seemed like the hotel primarily caters to couples, which made us feel uncomfortable and uneasy during our stay.
Overall, the experience was disappointing, and I would advise others to avoid this hotel if possible. The lack of professionalism and the inconvenience caused tarnished our trip to Gurgaon.
When we checked on google hotel still accepting the bookings for their main hotel. I think this is there regular business to take booking at main hotel and while check in send them to another one.
